tasks.title: Collect and organise three everyday objects
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use three safe everyday objects such as a pen, mug, notebook, charger or similar item.

tasks.title: Show a simple check, sort or tidy-up task
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Choose something harmless that can be demonstrated in a home, office or classroom.

tasks.title: Explain how you knew the task was complete
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Briefly explain what you checked and what told you the result was acceptable.

tasks.title: Write one thing you would improve next time
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Keep it simple: say what went well and one small improvement you would make.

preferred.label: 1 short written reflection
preferred.instruction: Write 2–4 sentences saying what went well and one thing you would improve if you repeated the activity.
